pipelines.name: MFR Ingest (RSMC La Réunion)
pipelines.description: Load Météo-France La Réunion tropical cyclone forecast tracks (South-West Indian Ocean) from the meteofr blob copy into storms.mfr_*, then compute their wind swaths and population exposure

columns.name: disturbance_id
columns.comment: {number}-{season}, e.g. 10-20252026: how Météo-France names a system before it is named

columns.name: cyclone_id
columns.comment: cyclone_id as in the file, e.g. SWI$10/20252026

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Cyclone name from the latest named forecast, or NULL while unnamed

columns.name: number
columns.comment: System number within the season

columns.name: season
columns.comment: Southern Hemisphere season, as the year it ends (20252026 -> 2026)

columns.name: genesis_basin
columns.comment: Standardized basin code: SI (South Indian)

columns.name: provider
columns.comment: mfr (Météo-France La Réunion, RSMC La Réunion)

columns.name: storm_id
columns.comment: Standardized identifier {name}_si_{season} (as in storms.ibtracs_storms), NULL while unnamed

columns.name: issued_time
columns.comment: reference_time in the file (UTC): the analysis time the forecast starts from. The hour in the filename is the upload hour, not this

columns.name: kind
columns.comment: forecast (the file has forecast points) or track (track-only file: the final track, sent when a system ends and revised later; one per system, its latest revision, whatever its reference time)

columns.name: update_time
columns.comment: update_time in the file (UTC): when Météo-France produced the file

columns.name: name_as_issued
columns.comment: cyclone_name as in the file, e.g. GEZANI, or 10-20252026 while unnamed

columns.name: data_source
columns.comment: Where the file came from: meteofr_blob (Data Factory copy of the Météo-France SFTP), ftp, backfill or local

columns.name: source_filename
columns.comment: Original filename, e.g. CMRSTRACK_SWI$10_20252026_GEZANI_2026_02_09_18Z.json

columns.name: content_sha256
columns.comment: SHA-256 of the raw file bytes

columns.name: raw_blob
columns.comment: Archived raw file: blob name in the storm container of the same stage

columns.name: n_analysis
columns.comment: Number of analysis points written (the system's track so far)

columns.name: n_forecast
columns.comment: Number of forecast points written (leadtime 0 included)

columns.name: max_leadtime
columns.comment: Longest forecast leadtime in hours, NULL without forecast points

columns.name: late_reissue
columns.comment: True for a forecast file produced more than 24 h after its reference time (Météo-France re-publishes some files long after); never replaces an operational forecast. Always false for track-only files

columns.name: uncertainty_cone
columns.comment: Météo-France uncertainty cone polygon (WGS84), made valid with ST_MakeValid. Its half-width matches position_accuracy

columns.name: ingested_at
columns.comment: When this forecast was last written (UTC)

columns.name: kind
columns.comment: kind of the file the point comes from (see mfr_forecasts.kind)

columns.name: data_type
columns.comment: analysis (observed track so far) or forecast (leadtime 0 = analysis at the reference time)

columns.name: leadtime
columns.comment: Hours after issued_time; negative for earlier analysis points (track-only files can have analysis points after it)

columns.name: development
columns.comment: Météo-France stage, e.g. disturbance, moderate tropical storm, intense tropical cyclone, inland

columns.name: wind_speed
columns.comment: maximum_wind.wind_speed_kt: 10-minute mean wind (knots)

columns.name: gust_speed
columns.comment: maximum_wind.wind_speed_gust_kt (knots)

columns.name: pressure
columns.comment: minimum_pressure: central pressure (hPa)

columns.name: max_wind_radius
columns.comment: maximum_wind.radius: radius of maximum winds (nautical miles)

columns.name: last_closed_isobar_pressure
columns.comment: last_closed_isobar.pressure (hPa)

columns.name: last_closed_isobar_radius
columns.comment: last_closed_isobar.radius (nautical miles)

columns.name: position_accuracy
columns.comment: position_accuracy: position uncertainty radius (nautical miles); equals the uncertainty cone half-width

columns.name: motion_speed
columns.comment: storm_motion.speed_kt (knots)

columns.name: motion_direction
columns.comment: storm_motion.direction_toward (degrees)

columns.name: dvorak_final_t
columns.comment: Dvorak.final_T_number

columns.name: dvorak_ci
columns.comment: Dvorak.current_intensity

columns.name: quadrant_radius_27
columns.comment: JSON array [NE,SE,SW,NW]: 27-knot radii by quadrant (nautical miles), CXML product only

columns.name: quadrant_radius_28
columns.comment: JSON array [NE,SE,SW,NW]: 28-knot radii by quadrant (nautical miles)

columns.name: quadrant_radius_34
columns.comment: JSON array [NE,SE,SW,NW]: 34-knot radii by quadrant (nautical miles)

columns.name: quadrant_radius_48
columns.comment: JSON array [NE,SE,SW,NW]: 48-knot radii by quadrant (nautical miles)

columns.name: quadrant_radius_50
columns.comment: JSON array [NE,SE,SW,NW]: 50-knot radii by quadrant (nautical miles), CXML product only

columns.name: quadrant_radius_64
columns.comment: JSON array [NE,SE,SW,NW]: 64-knot radii by quadrant (nautical miles)

columns.name: raw_fields
columns.comment: Every other point property with a value, keyed by its path in the file

columns.name: storm_id
columns.comment: The system's storm_id (as in mfr_storms), on every point once the system is named, including forecasts issued before; NULL while unnamed

columns.name: point_id
columns.comment: Unique identifier (UUID) for this track point

columns.name: geometry
columns.comment: Point geometry in WGS84 (EPSG:4326), longitude in [-180, 180)

columns.name: source
columns.comment: meteofr_blob (Data Factory copy of the Météo-France SFTP), ftp, backfill or local

columns.name: source_path
columns.comment: Blob name or FTP filename the file was read from

columns.name: source_filename
columns.comment: Filename, e.g. CMRSTRACK_SWI$10_20252026_GEZANI_2026_02_09_18Z.json

columns.name: size_bytes
columns.comment: Size in bytes from the source listing (else of the bytes read)

columns.name: source_modified
columns.comment: Modification time from the latest source listing that showed this content (UTC)

columns.name: first_seen
columns.comment: First time this file was read (UTC)

columns.name: last_seen
columns.comment: Last listing this file was in (UTC)

columns.name: status
columns.comment: written: became the stored forecast/track; unchanged: same content already stored; kept_existing: a different version that did not replace the stored one (older, or a late re-issue); failed: could not be read

columns.name: message
columns.comment: Why, for kept_existing and failed

pipelines.name: South Pacific FMS Pipeline - LIVE, from branch

pipelines.name: [dev adm_hker1] OneGMS Drift Checker

columns.name: gdacs_eventid
columns.comment: GDACS native event identifier (e.g. 1001067 for BERYL-24)

columns.name: gdacs_episodeid
columns.comment: GDACS episode (advisory) identifier — one episode per ~6h model run

columns.name: valid_time
columns.comment: Timestamp of the episode (most recent advisory included in the cumulative buffer, UTC)

columns.name: wind_speed_kt
columns.comment: Wind speed threshold in knots (34, 50, or 64). GDACS buffer39 maps to 34 kt, buffer74 maps to 64 kt; 50 kt is not produced by GDACS.

columns.name: admin_level
columns.comment: Administrative level (0 = country, 1 = first subnational, etc.)

columns.name: iso3
columns.comment: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (parent country at admin_level=1). Standardized via ocha_lens.datasources.gdacs.to_iso3() — GDACS proprietary codes like XJE (Jersey) are remapped to the official ISO3 (JEY).

columns.name: admin_name
columns.comment: Admin unit name as reported by GDACS — CNTRY_NAME at admin_level=0, ADMIN_NAME at admin_level=1. Always populated.

columns.name: gdacs_admin_code
columns.comment: Native GDACS admin code preserved as-is. At admin_level=0: GMI_CNTRY (= iso3 except for territories with X-prefixed proprietary codes). At admin_level=1: GMI_ADMIN (e.g., USA-ARK for Arkansas, XJE-JE for Jersey-as-region) — country-prefixed proprietary, not a standard humanitarian pcode.

columns.name: pcode
columns.comment: Admin unit p-code. Nullable: populated as iso3 at admin_level=0; null at admin_level=1 until backfilled by a downstream enrichment step (GDACS only emits proprietary FIPS_ADMIN/GMI_ADMIN codes, not standard pcodes).

columns.name: pop_exposed
columns.comment: Population count exposed within this admin unit to this wind buffer, as reported by GDACS. NULL when GDACS legitimately omits POP_AFFECTED (typically: country intersected the wind footprint geometrically but no population is exposed at that wind threshold).

columns.name: adam_eventid
columns.comment: ADAM native event identifier (integer; ADAM also exposes a string ``uid`` field which is not stored here)

columns.name: adam_episodeid
columns.comment: ADAM episode identifier — one episode per advisory; latest-per-event used in the historical compile

columns.name: valid_time
columns.comment: Timestamp of the episode (most recent advisory included in the cumulative footprint, UTC)

columns.name: wind_speed_kt
columns.comment: Wind speed threshold in knots (34, 50, or 64). ADAM 60/90/120 km/h thresholds are mapped to 34/50/64 kt for cross-source comparability.

columns.name: admin_level
columns.comment: Administrative level (0 = country, 1 = first subnational, 2 = second subnational). ADAM CSV is at admin_level=2; admin_level=0 and =1 rows are aggregated by the pipeline.

columns.name: iso3
columns.comment: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (parent country at admin_level=1,2). Nullable when ADAM's ADM0_NAME cannot be mapped via pycountry + overrides (rare: disputed territories).

columns.name: admin_name
columns.comment: Admin unit name as reported by ADAM — ADM0_NAME at admin_level=0, ADM1_NAME at admin_level=1, ADM2_NAME at admin_level=2. Always populated.

columns.name: parent_admin_name
columns.comment: Name of the parent admin unit — null at admin_level=0, ADM0_NAME at admin_level=1, ADM1_NAME at admin_level=2. Lets consumers walk the hierarchy without joins.

columns.name: pcode
columns.comment: Admin unit p-code. Nullable: populated as iso3 at admin_level=0; null at admin_level=1 until backfilled by a downstream enrichment step (ADAM only emits an admin name at ADM1, no code).

columns.name: pop_exposed
columns.comment: Population count exposed within this admin unit to this wind threshold, as reported by ADAM

columns.name: gdacs_eventid
columns.comment: GDACS native event id. Primary key in the MVP — every row originates from a GDACS event ingest.

columns.name: atcf_id
columns.comment: NHC ATCF storm id (e.g. AL142024); nullable. Populated by run_pipeline.py match.

columns.name: sid
columns.comment: IBTrACS serial id; nullable. Populated by a future IBTrACS-side enrichment step.

columns.name: adam_eventid
columns.comment: WFP ADAM event id; nullable. Often equal to gdacs_eventid (ADAM ingests GDACS upstream), confirmed by a future ADAM-side enrichment step.

columns.name: last_updated
columns.comment: Auto-set on insert; bump on update via the matching pipeline if you want to track linkage churn.

pipelines.name: Cuba Hurricane Forecast Monitor
pipelines.description: Monitor the Cuba trigger from NHC forecast wind exposure, triggered by each NHC Pipeline run
pipelines.schedule: Triggered by NHC Pipeline, [dev adm_tdowning] NHC Pipeline

pipelines.name: Cuba Hurricane Observational Monitor
pipelines.description: Monitor the Cuba trigger from observed NHC wind exposure

pipelines.name: Storm Alert
pipelines.description: Email subscribers when NHC forecast or observed cyclone exposure crosses a country threshold; park the season's per-storm exposure CSVs on blob for HDX

pipelines.name: Run FloodScan
pipelines.description: Get SFED and MFED flood fraction estimates from [AER](https://published.aer.com/floodscan/aer_floodscan_support.html)

pipelines.name: Run ERA5
pipelines.description: Get ECMWF's ERA5 reanalysis precipitation from the [Copernicus Climate Data Store](https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/)
pipelines.schedule: At 12:00, on day 6 of the month UTC

pipelines.name: Run IMERG
pipelines.description: Retrieve NASA's [IMERG precipitation data](https://gpm.nasa.gov/data/imerg)

pipelines.name: Run SEAS5
pipelines.description: Retrieve the ECMWF [SEAS5](https://www.ecmwf.int/en/newsletter/154/meteorology/ecmwfs-new-long-range-forecasting-system-seas5) seasonal precipitation forecasts
pipelines.schedule: At 12:30, on day 5 of the month UTC
